official.university: Flemish Government / VLUHR - Vlaamse Universiteiten Hogescholen Raad
official.funding_label: Scholarship of EUR 10,225 per academic year plus reduced tuition fee
official.deadline_note: For the 2026-2027 cycle the scholarship launched in January 2026, Mobility-Online opened on 16 February 2026 and the deadline was 27 April 2026 at 23:59 GMT+1, with selection in May 2026 and mobility starting September 2026. VLUHR states the scholarship is under review by the Ministry of Education, so the grant, selection process, criteria and modalities may change for the academic year 2027-2028; no new dates have been published.
official.application_cycle: 2026-2027 cycle (launch January 2026, deadline 27 April 2026, selection May 2026, mobility September 2026); 2027-2028 under review by the Ministry of Education
official.status_note: VLUHR states: 'Note that the scholarship is currently under review by the Ministry of Education and as such, the awarded grant, selection process, criteria, and modalities may change for the academic year 2027-2028.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: The Host institution can ask the applicant for a tuition fee that equals the lowest rate of the yearly tuition fee for a student who receives a study grant from the Flemish Government. The rate for the academic year 2026-2027 is EUR 136,50.
benefits: A maximum scholarship of EUR 10,225 per academic year

The Host institution can only charge a tuition fee equal to the lowest rate of the yearly tuition fee for a student who receives a study grant from the Flemish Government - EUR 136,50 for the academic year 2026-2027
Duration of mobility: one academic year for a master programme of 60 ECTS, two academic years for a master programme of 120 ECTS
Student mobility during the master programme is allowed, provided at least half of the credits are obtained at the Flemish Host institution
Reserved scholarships for students from Japan (3), Mexico (3), Palestine (2) and USA (5)
The scholarship is paid via annual installments and the final installment is deducted if a one-year Master programme is not completed with the Master degree
eligibility: The applicant applies to take up a Master degree programme at a Flemish higher education institution
Grade Point Average of 3.5 out of 4.0, calculated on the last obtained Bachelors or Masters degree

Good knowledge of English: IELTS overall band minimum 7.0, TOEFL minimum total 94, C1 level of the CEFR, or a similar result in another official language test recognized by the Host institution. School of Arts: IELTS minimum 6.5, TOEFL minimum total 90, B2 of the CEFR or a similar result
The Host institution also performs an academic check of the student's file; the student has to be accepted by the Host institution to be able to receive the scholarship
The applicant can be nominated by only one Flemish higher education institution

Previous degree(s) should have been obtained at a higher education institution outside Flanders; international students who have been on credit mobility in a hosting Flemish higher education institution are still eligible
All nationalities, except Russian, can apply

Students already enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution cannot apply, except international students enrolled in a specific preparatory programme in spring 2026 who start a master programme in September 2026
Students who have previously received a Master Mind scholarship cannot apply again
Not eligible for 2026-2027: preparatory programmes, bridging programmes, distance learning
requirements: The student has to be accepted by the Host institution to be able to receive the scholarship, even if the Host institution's decision is taken after the selection
A maximum of 20 applications can be submitted per Flemish higher education institution
Internal deadlines set by the Host institution may differ from the programme deadline
Upon completion of the mobility, all students are expected to submit an essay for which a format is provided, and to fill in a short questionnaire about their mobility
Students should not combine the Master Mind scholarship with another scholarship from the Flemish Government, an Erasmus+ or Erasmus Mundus scholarship, a BAEF scholarship, or a Fulbright scholarship
If a student completes a one-year Master programme but does not obtain the Master degree at the end of the academic year, the final installment of EUR 1,525 will not be awarded
documents: Copy of the International passport or national ID
A Curriculum Vitae including your American GPA out of 4.0 and, where applicable, publications, academic awards and previous scholarships
Transcript of records with a certified translation if written in another language than Dutch, French, German or English
English language test results, or a letter of exemption provided by the Host university
Letter of motivation written in English
Two signed letters of recommendation from professors of your previous home university, university of applied sciences, school of Arts or a recent employer, written in English
Copy of acquired diploma(s) with a certified translation if written in another language than Dutch, French, German or English
Three reasons of motivation for submission (at least 150 words) formulated in English by the Host institution and uploaded by the Host institution
selection_criteria: Quality of the applicant's motivation: 30 points
The applicant's previous study results in the Transcript of records: 30 points
The reasons for recommending the applicant in Recommendation letter 1: 10 points
The reasons for recommending the applicant in Recommendation letter 2: 10 points
The motivation for submission by the Host institution: 10 points
The top talent profile of the applicant: 10 points
Each application is read by two independent jury members; if more than 10% difference between the scores, the file is reopened and reevaluated
coverage: A maximum scholarship of EUR 10,225 per academic year, for one academic year (60 ECTS) or two academic years (120 ECTS)
Tuition fee reduced to the lowest study-grant rate of EUR 136,50 for the academic year 2026-2027
EUR 1,525 of the scholarship is withheld as final installment and only paid on obtaining the Master degree for one-year programmes
application_method: Step 1: the applicant submits the application to the Host institution (internal deadlines may differ)
Step 2: the Host institution accepts the application of the candidate
Step 3: the Host institution starts the application procedure by creating the candidate's application file in the Mobility-Online tool
Step 4: the applicant registers in Mobility-Online and completes the application file before the deadline, uploading the documents listed
Step 5: the Host institution validates and submits the completed application file before the deadline
official.application_route: Apply to the Flemish Host institution first; the institution then creates your application file in the Mobility-Online tool, you complete it, and the institution validates and submits it before the deadline.
official.study_mode: Full-time Master programme at a Flemish higher education institution: Flemish universities, Schools of Arts and the Antwerp Maritime Academy
official.citizenship_residency: All nationalities, except Russian, can apply; previous degree(s) should have been obtained at a higher education institution outside Flanders
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the Flemish Government awards the scholarship in order to promote Flemish higher education as a top study destination for international talents; all nationalities except Russian are eligible
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master degree programme at a Flemish higher education institution, including Flemish universities, Schools of Arts and the Antwerp Maritime Academy; preparatory, bridging and distance learning programmes are not eligible
official.duration: One academic year for a 60 ECTS master programme; two academic years for a 120 ECTS master programme. At least half of the credits must be obtained at the Flemish Host institution
official.description: The Flemish Government grants Master Mind Scholarships to excellent students who (want to) follow a master's programme at a Flemish college or university, in order to promote Flemish higher education as a top study destination for international talents. Accepted applications come from all Flemish universities, Schools of Arts and the Antwerp Maritime Academy.
official.program_type: Government scholarship for international master's students
official.english_requirement: IELTS overall band minimum 7.0 or TOEFL minimum total score 94 (Schools of Arts: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL 90), C1 level of the CEFR (B2 for Schools of Arts), or a similar result in another official language test recognized by the Host institution. Proof no older than 3 years at the time of application processing in April. Online tests such as IELTS Indicator and the TOEFL iBT Special Home Edition are accepted.

verification.notes: Maximum scholarship of EUR 10,225 per academic year, the tuition-fee rule with the EUR 136,50 rate for 2026-2027, the 3.5 out of 4.0 GPA and English requirements, eligibility and exclusion rules, the full document list, the 100-point scoring scheme, the Mobility-Online application steps, the country-reserved slots and the scholarship-combination restrictions were read on VLUHR International's own Master Mind page and the studyinflanders.be mirror hosted by a Flemish institution. The published cycle is 2026-2027 and VLUHR states that the scholarship is currently under review by the Ministry of Education for the academic year 2027-2028, so no confirmed next deadline or amount is recorded.

applicant_utility.summary: The Master Mind Scholarship gives you EUR 10,225 per academic year at a Flemish university, School of Arts or the Antwerp Maritime Academy, and cuts your tuition to the lowest study-grant rate of EUR 136,50 rather than the full international price. You do not apply to VLUHR directly: your Flemish host institution must nominate you, creates your file in the Mobility-Online tool and then validates and submits it. The published 2026-2027 round closed on 27 April 2026 and VLUHR has flagged the programme as under review by the Ministry of Education for 2027-2028, so confirm the current rules before you invest time.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Excellent international Master's applicants with a GPA of at least 3.5 out of 4.0 on their last degree, English at IELTS 7.0 or TOEFL 94 (or C1), and a profile a Flemish host institution will actively want to nominate. Because scoring puts 30 points on motivation and 30 on your transcript, strong grades plus a genuinely argued motivation letter are the combination that wins; the host's own 10-point submission statement and two academic references carry the remainder.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm you hold a GPA of at least 3.5 out of 4.0 on your last obtained Bachelors or Masters degree
Confirm you are not a Russian national, and that your previous degree was obtained outside Flanders
Take IELTS (minimum 7.0), TOEFL (minimum 94), or reach C1 - Schools of Arts applicants need IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 90 or B2; proof no older than 3 years
Confirm you are not already enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution and have not previously held a Master Mind scholarship
Choose your Flemish programme and check that it is not a preparatory, bridging or distance learning programme
Apply to the host institution well before its own internal deadline
Get accepted by the host institution

Register in Mobility-Online once the host creates your file and upload the profile picture, passport or ID, CV with your American GPA, transcript, language proof, motivation letter, two signed English reference letters and diploma copies
Ask the host to upload the three reasons of motivation for submission in English
Have the host validate and submit the completed file before the deadline
common_rejection_risks: Missing the host institution's internal deadline, which is usually earlier than the programme deadline
A GPA below 3.5 out of 4.0 on the last obtained degree
Applying as a Russian national, or holding a previous degree obtained in Flanders
Already being enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution, or having previously held the scholarship
Applying for a preparatory, bridging or distance learning programme
Language proof older than 3 years at the time of processing in April, or a test below the threshold
Being nominated by more than one Flemish institution
A host institution exceeding its maximum of 20 applications and not nominating you
Combining the Master Mind with a Flemish Government, Erasmus+, Erasmus Mundus, BAEF or Fulbright scholarship
Attempting to move your whole 120 ECTS degree to the host, since at least half the credits must be obtained there
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: With EUR 10,225 per academic year and a EUR 136,50 tuition fee, you run a Belgian academic year on roughly EUR 800 to 900 a month, which is workable in most Flemish student cities but tight in Brussels, Leuven and Ghent. The final EUR 1,525 installment is withheld until a one-year Master degree is actually obtained, so plan a short-term buffer.
applicant_utility.document_audit: Transcripts and diplomas in any language other than Dutch, French, German or English require certified translations. Two of the nine items - the profile picture and the host's three-reasons-of-motivation statement - are easy to leave out, and the second one has to be uploaded by the host institution, not by you.
alerts: The scholarship is currently under review by the Ministry of Education, so the grant, selection process, criteria and modalities may change for the academic year 2027-2028
The published 2026-2027 deadline was 27 April 2026 at 23:59 GMT+1
Reserved scholarships for students from Japan (3), Mexico (3), Palestine (2) and USA (5) are only awarded if there are sufficient strong candidates for the reserved participants
Tuition is capped at EUR 136,50 for the academic year 2026-2027, equal to the lowest study-grant rate
The last Flemish higher education institution to submit valid applications - Polytechniek HKU in 2026 - was only awarded 1 scholarship out of 17 applications
A ranked waiting list is created if more eligible applications come in than there are scholarships
submission_workflow: Read the VLUHR Master Mind page and confirm the current cycle rules with your host institution
Choose your Flemish programme and check the host's own internal deadline
Apply and secure acceptance from the host institution
Complete the language test and have the result ready
Register in Mobility-Online once the host creates your file
Upload all documents including the profile picture, passport, CV with American GPA, transcript, language proof, motivation letter and two signed English reference letters
Have the host upload the three reasons of motivation for submission
Let the host validate and submit the completed file before the deadline
After the mobility, submit the essay in the provided format and fill in the short questionnaire

official.deadline_note: Applications for the 2026-2027 scholarship were open from 15 October 2025 and closed on 15 January 2026 at 23.59 CET. KU Leuven publishes a separate scholarship page for each academic year, so the 2027-2028 dates are announced on a new page at that time.

official.status_note: The published 2026-2027 cycle closed on 15 January 2026 at 23.59 CET. Only 1 scholarship was available for 2026-2027, and KU Leuven states that due to the large number of candidates no personal feedback on the selection process will be provided.

benefits: Scholarship type: Full fee waiver and Allowance
Incoming students will receive a scholarship of EUR 13,200 per academic year, for a maximum of 2 academic years

Through one application process, you will automatically be considered for the Master Mind Scholarship, the KU Leuven ASEAN Scholarship, the KU Leuven Scholarship for Africa and the KU Leuven Scholarship for Central and South America (the last three on the condition that you have one of the eligible nationalities)

Applicants whose first language is not English must demonstrate a good knowledge and command of English

Students may not combine the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship with any other scholarship

KU Leuven Scholarships & Master Mind Candidacy Form, uploaded under document type 'Annexe'

official.application_route: Apply to an eligible KU Leuven master's programme with the Candidacy Form as an annexe, then register the scholarship candidacy in the online registration tool before 15 January.

official.citizenship_residency: All nationalities are eligible; previous degree(s) should have been obtained at a higher education institution outside Flanders
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Master's programmes from KU Leuven's published eligible-programmes list for 2026-2027; students enrolled in preparatory programmes, bridging programmes and distance learning programmes are not eligible for the Master Mind Scholarships

official.description: The Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship is a fully-funded scholarship for outstanding students, available for all master's and advanced master's programmes at KU Leuven and financed by the KU Leuven International Scholarship Fund. For 2026-2027, one scholarship was available, and holders receive a full tuition fee waiver and a scholarship of EUR 13.200 per academic year for a maximum of two academic years.
official.program_type: University scholarship for outstanding master's students
official.english_requirement: Online TOEFL minimum overall score 94, IELTS minimum overall score 7, or Cambridge CPE minimum level C2. Students who have previously completed an English-taught programme in Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States do not need to submit a certificate. The language test must be taken before the application deadline of 15 January, although language test results can be added after the deadline.

verification.notes: Scholarship type of full fee waiver and allowance, the EUR 13,200 per academic year for a maximum of two academic years, the circa EUR 140 administration fee, the 1 scholarship available for 2026-2027, the eligibility and disqualifying conditions, the two-step application process, the English test thresholds and exemptions, and the two-stage selection (faculty nomination by 10 March 2026, then the central KU Leuven Selection Committee) were read on KU Leuven's own Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship page for academic year 2026-2027 (page last updated 20 April 2026). Travel coverage is not published, so it is null. KU Leuven publishes one page per academic year, so the next cycle's dates and scholarship count are not yet available.

applicant_utility.summary: KU Leuven's Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship is one of the very top Belgian awards: EUR 13,200 per academic year for up to two years plus a full tuition waiver, leaving only an administration fee of around EUR 140. The critical word is eligible - KU Leuven publishes a restricted list of eligible programmes each year, and only 1 scholarship was available for 2026-2027. Your file is not reviewed centrally first: your master's programme at KU Leuven nominates you, and only then does the central KU Leuven Selection Committee decide, so the nomination step effectively decides the outcome.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Outstanding international students applying to a KU Leuven master's programme that appears on the current eligible-programmes list, with an excellent GPA on the transcript of records, academic awards, and a demonstrated record of leadership or commitment. Because previous degree(s) should have been obtained at a higher education institution outside Flanders, this is aimed at genuinely incoming students rather than people already inside the Flemish system.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your programme appears on KU Leuven's published list of eligible programmes for the current academic year

Check your English level: TOEFL overall 94, IELTS overall 7, or Cambridge CPE C2, or a qualifying English-taught degree from Australia, English-speaking Canada, Ireland, New Zealand, the UK or the USA
Confirm you are not already enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution and have a previous degree from outside Flanders
Fill out the KU Leuven Scholarships & Master Mind Candidacy Form
Submit a complete application file for the eligible master's programme with the Candidacy Form as an annexe under document type 'Annexe'
Register your scholarship candidacy through the online registration tool
Take the language test before 15 January
If nominated, submit a one-minute motivational video by 18 March
common_rejection_risks: Applying for a programme that is not on KU Leuven's published eligible-programmes list
Not being nominated by your faculty in the first step, since only nominated candidates reach the central Selection Committee
Previous degree obtained at a Flemish higher education institution
Already being enrolled at a Flemish higher education institution, or having previously obtained a Master Mind or Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship
Applying for a preparatory, bridging or distance learning programme
Taking the language test after 15 January, even though the result may be submitted later
Combining the Inspiring the Outstanding Scholarship with any other scholarship
Only 1 scholarship was available for 2026-2027, so the odds are extremely low
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: With the full fee waiver, the circa EUR 140 administration fee and EUR 13.200 per academic year, living in Leuven works out to roughly EUR 900 to 1.000 per month, so the allowance is close to full coverage but not guaranteed to cover everything, and travel, visa and setup costs come out of it.
applicant_utility.document_audit: The Candidacy Form must be uploaded under document type 'Annexe' - uploading it under a different document type is a common way to be silently excluded. The one-minute motivational video is only required for nominated candidates, but it is due by 18 March, so have it recorded before results come out.
